data.one_liner: Spring curves for Flutter animations based on real physics equations.
data.what_it_does: Sprung provides physics-based Curve implementations for Flutter animations, including underDamped, criticallyDamped, overDamped, and custom spring simulations using damping, stiffness, mass, and velocity.
use_when: You want physics-based motion for your Flutter animations
You need custom spring damping and stiffness values for Curves
You want reliable curve accuracy with minimal error
avoid_when: You are looking for a complete animation orchestration library like flutter_animate
You only need standard non-physics Flutter curves
strengths: Based on real physics equations leveraging Newton's Second Law and Hooke's Law
Offers simple pre-built curves like underDamped, criticallyDamped, and overDamped
weaknesses: Limited to spring curve definitions for standard Flutter animations

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you need a comprehensive, chainable animation framework rather than just physics-based curves.

alternatives.name: animate_do
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you want ready-to-use entrance animations.

alternatives.name: rive
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you require complex vector animations and interactive state machines.
